# Vendored code

ClipLab ships these files unchanged, so it needs nothing from pip.

| File | What | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qrcodegen.py` | QR Code generator library (Python), used for the phone-access QR code in Settings > More | [Project Nayuki](https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library), [nayuki/QR-Code-generator](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator) `python/qrcodegen.py` at commit `3c6d0b3cefb4e049dc337e82237c9644399716a8` (SHA-256 `9f4ed1dd201dcb92b1bc0d6e14f46c754bcff0ce48580c5d7e8ace8f6926c8ef`) | MIT, Copyright (c) Project Nayuki; the full notice is at the top of the file |

To update a file, replace it with the new upstream version, then update the commit and SHA-256 above.
